fact: A communiqué of the education ministry's Secretary General dated 4 November 2025 says SOSUP is about to launch online the national operation identifying enrolled learners for school year 2025/2026 in public and private pre-primary, primary and secondary establishments, that heads of establishment enter their school's details through an online form in a second identification phase from 5 to 30 November 2025, and that pupils of establishments not identified cannot be identified.
title: Gabon : lancement de la seconde phase d'identification des établissements publics et privés du 05 au 30 novembre
